title: Grateful Dead Live at Community War Memorial Auditorium on 1982-04-09

ai_review.summary: Clean audience recording captures a high‑energy show highlighted by a sparkling Bird Song and solid first‑set jams, though some note a hollow sound.
ai_review.review: The tape offers an audience (AUD) source that is surprisingly clear and well‑positioned, despite occasional comments about a hollow quality. Musically the concert shines with a standout Bird Song and tight, dancing first‑set jams, delivering a high‑energy vibe throughout.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers gave 4–5 stars and praised the performance; recording quality is generally good but noted as slightly hollow, leading to a solid combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Listeners describe the AUD track as very clean, clear and well‑positioned on the floor with no blemishes, though a few note a hollow or thin sound character.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set delivers loose, dancing vibes with solid jams; overall the concert maintains an upbeat, cohesive flow and ends on a strong note.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Multiple reviewers praise Jerry's playing – citing a “last great Jerry period,” his tone on Bird Song, and tight lead work throughout.
